description: Bean qou-wgnx/qou-wiub. THE DECISIVE A=3 magnitude check: evaluate the closed-form C1 connection cross-ratio chi(P) (E-carrier of the A=3 anti-self-adjoint lift, BirkhoffAmplitudeE.lean E=chi(P)) at the DERIVED substrate parameters (proton q0, alpha=t2/T, theta nome p=sqrt(q0), all fixed by C1's operator L1, NO tuning) and compare its MAGNITUDE to the A=3 lift r* = mu3/c3 ~ 1.585. RESULT: chi(P) on the real axis is a PURE UNIT-MODULUS PHASE, |chi|=1 EXACTLY (dev < 1e-30; matches exp(2i(arg c+ - arg c-)) to 1e-121), and is a z-dependent elliptic function (arg chi = -0.488/-1.921/+1.310/+3.052 at z=0.30/0.45/0.60/0.75) -- not a single number. r* is a real magnitude > 1; a unit phase cannot equal it. So chi(P)|q0 does NOT numerically supply r*: SCOPE-(a) NEGATIVE for the direct identity chi(P)=r*. This does NOT refute the gauge-invariance argument E=chi(P) (BirkhoffAmplitudeWellPosed); it shows the computed VALUE of that cross-ratio is a phase, so the magnitude r* is not chi(P) itself but at most a real functional of it fed through the affine lift factor_sa - slope*E (A3AntiSelfAdjointLift). Consistent with the whole A=3 magnitude program: every trace/cross-ratio object gives modulus 1 (option-e.md: 'r* ~ 1.585 != 1 is NOT supplied'). NOT tuned; NOTHING wired to production.

verdict: SCOPE-(a) NEGATIVE. chi(P)|q0 (proton pin) is a pure unit-modulus phase, |chi|=1 exactly, a z-dependent elliptic function -- NOT the real magnitude r* = mu3/c3 ~ 1.585. The closed form (C1ConnectionPoles.lean) and the direct connection matrix agree. The A=3 magnitude is therefore NOT closed by the naive identity chi(P)=r*: a unit phase cannot equal a real magnitude > 1. This SHARPENS rather than refutes the E=chi(P) well-posedness argument: what remains genuinely open is the bridge from the (now-computed) unit-phase cross-ratio to the real anti-self-adjoint amplitude E that the affine lift factor_sa - (B D^-1/A) E needs, and whether that yields r*. The cross-ratio's numeric value is NO LONGER open (it is a phase); the phase->real-amplitude->lift chain is. Not tuned; nothing wired.
